description: A mounted warrior in chainmail and a helmet with a plume rides a rearing brown horse and thrusts a long lance toward a howdah on an armoured grey elephant. Soldiers in mail and round shields swing swords around them, and fallen figures lie in the dust. A small faint mark sits in the lower right corner.
